I recently refactored some code for a Bitovi client, Strategic Wealth Preservation. We used GitHub Copilot Agent mode with Claude Sonnet 4 to adjust the code formatting and linting rules for SWP's codebase.

SWP uses a monorepo for several of their internal projects. These projects each have their own Prettier config. Only the public-facing website project had an ESLint config. They wanted one shared config for both Prettier and ESLint.

After some experimentation, I figured out a way to have my Copilot agent implement new features with a single command.
